entries.behaviorChange: Replaced plain === comparison on hex digests with crypto.timingSafeEqual
entries.risk: HIGH — currently merged into #147 without the strict hex/decoded-length validation the directive requires; timingSafeEqual throws on unequal-length buffers, which is itself a timing/availability signal if inputs aren't length-validated first
entries.validationRequired: Add strict hex-charset + decoded-byte-length validation before timingSafeEqual; tests for valid, invalid-length, invalid-hex, case-sensitivity, non-throw-on-malformed-input
entries.finalDecision: DO NOT MERGE #147 until this is redesigned per the directive's 3.5/hash-validation requirement

entries.behaviorChange: Added auth()+isAdminSession() guards to logHandoff/logSubagentRun/reviewSubagentRun; reordered input validation before the auth check
entries.risk: HIGH — no actor-identity design (interactive admin vs. background service vs. owner-only), no typed Unauthorized/Forbidden errors, no audit receipt, no negative tests for the auth boundary itself (only for validation-before-auth ordering)
entries.canonicalOwner: apps/web/lib/jarvis (pre-existing; #146 adds a DIFFERENT file, lib/jarvis/nova-agent.ts, for NOVA's council-seat contract — no direct code overlap, but both files sit under the same JARVIS authority model)
entries.overlapWith146: conceptual only — #146's nova-agent.ts declares its own external-actions=false / runtimeStatus=DESIGNED contract; the JARVIS council's actor/authority model this PR touches should be the single source of truth both defer to
entries.validationRequired: Actor-identity taxonomy, typed auth errors, auth-before-sensitive-validation threat analysis, negative tests, audit receipt
entries.finalDecision: DO NOT MERGE #147 until this is redesigned; separate security-review PR recommended per the directive

entries.behaviorChange: Added auth()+isAdminSession() guards to takeAction/decideAppeal/listOpenReports/listActions/auditLog — these server actions previously had no auth check at all
entries.risk: HIGH — same actor-identity gap as ledgers.ts; this is the more severe of the two since these actions previously had ZERO auth (not just a check-ordering bug)
entries.validationRequired: Same as ledgers.ts — actor identity, typed errors, audit receipt, negative tests
entries.finalDecision: Recommend splitting into its OWN PR separate from ledgers.ts/hash.ts per the directive — this is the highest-severity individual fix in the whole set and deserves isolated review, not bundling

entries.behaviorChange: Added an idempotency key (userId+priceId) to Stripe checkout session creation
entries.risk: HIGH — REJECT_UNSAFE as currently written. A static key derived only from user+price can (a) replay an old completed Checkout Session on a legitimate NEW purchase attempt, or (b) collapse two distinct legitimate purchase intents (e.g. resubscribe after cancellation) into one
entries.canonicalOwner: apps/web/lib/stripe.ts (pre-existing, no #146 equivalent — NOVA's monetization.ts models revenue LANES conceptually but has no payment-execution code)
entries.overlapWith146: none in code; NOVA's monetization.ts subscription lane lists 'real payment receipt' as required proof — this Stripe path is the actual mechanism that would produce that receipt, so it is implicitly load-bearing for NOVA's future revenue tracking even though no file overlaps
entries.validationRequired: Redesign to a durable checkout-attempt/order ID minted once per distinct purchase intent, reused only for retrying that SAME intent; tests for replay-prevention and distinct-intent-non-collision
entries.replacementPr: #147 (this file must be pulled OUT of #147 and redesigned before any merge)
entries.finalDecision: DO NOT MERGE as-is. Split into payments/checkout-attempt-idempotency per the revised stack.

entries.behaviorChange: 8e18072 added a VOID path for completed+scoreless games; 7120a1b narrowed it to only fire when game.status is SCHEDULED/LIVE, restoring a no-op update otherwise
entries.risk: HIGH — REJECT_UNSAFE as currently written, confirmed by direct code inspection this session. Current logic still infers POSTPONED status from a SINGLE observation of completed=true + missing scores, with no corroboration from an explicit source status field, no quarantine state, and the game-status update + pick-void update are two SEPARATE non-transactional writes (not atomic), with no check of actual updated-row counts
entries.validationRequired: Quarantine record instead of inferring POSTPONED; require explicit source status or repeated corroborating observations; wrap game+pick updates in one transaction; verify actual updated-row counts
entries.replacementPr: #147 (this file must be pulled OUT of #147 and redesigned before any merge)
entries.finalDecision: DO NOT MERGE as-is. Split into settlement/missing-score-quarantine per the revised stack. This is a real-money-settlement correctness bug, the highest-consequence unresolved item in the entire disposition.

entries.behaviorChange: Added -U sports to the pg_isready health-cmd so the CI Postgres health check authenticates as the sports role instead of the passwordless root OS user
entries.risk: LOW — narrow, mechanical, independently verifiable fix for a real CI flake (confirmed this session: without it, health checks spin for the full job duration logging 'role "root" does not exist')
entries.overlapWith146: none — #146 adds its OWN separate workflow file, .github/workflows/nova-verification.yml, for NOVA's focused test suite; no conflict
entries.validationRequired: Independent run on fresh main confirming the health check passes without the 'role root' spam
entries.finalDecision: Safe to extract independently of the higher-risk files in #147 — recommend actually splitting fix/ci-postgres-health into its own tiny PR per the revised stack, since it has zero relation to the auth/payment/settlement risk cluster

entries.canonicalOwner: NEW concept, this branch — must converge with #146's monetization.ts moneyState lifecycle (eligible→applied→approved→activated→earned→invoiced→paid) rather than run as an independent state model
entries.overlapWith146: CONCEPTUAL — #146's OpportunityCandidate.economics.moneyState tracks credit-program lifecycle for DISCOVERED opportunities (research-time); cost-policy.ts's LLM_COST_MODE controls RUNTIME dispatch behavior per AI call. These are different layers (discovery vs. execution) but must read from ONE credit-truth source, not two independently-computed ones
entries.validationRequired: See AI_CONTROL_PLANE_ADR — missing-mode fail-closed, central enforcement (import-boundary CI guard), typed AiInvocation/AiAttempt/AiFinancialAttribution records instead of a single LlmDispatchRecord
entries.finalDecision: Retain as the FOUNDATION layer of the eventual AI control plane facade — do not discard, but do not treat as finished. Converge its funding-state concepts with #146's monetization.ts before further build-out.
